title: Build multi-page website for Launchpad Studio with demo store and product detail pages

requirements.text: Create multi-page navigation structure with separate routes for Home, Services, Launch Packages/Pricing, Demo Store, How It Works, Testimonials, and Contact/Book a Consultation pages

quotes: The website must be multi-page, not a single scrolling page
Each navigation item must open a new page, not scroll within the same page

acceptanceCriteria: Navigation menu visible on all pages with links to each section
Clicking navigation links loads separate page routes, not scroll anchors
All 7 pages are accessible via navigation

requirements.text: Build Home page with business overview, testimonial preview section, and strong CTA buttons for 'Book Free Consultation' and 'View Launch Packages'

quotes: A testimonial preview section on the Home page
Minimal homepage clutter focused on overview and conversion

acceptanceCriteria: Home page displays Launchpad Studio business description
Preview of 2-3 testimonials visible on Home page
At least two prominent CTA buttons present
CTAs link to relevant pages (Contact and Launch Packages)

requirements.text: Create Services page detailing brand identity and visual design, website and portfolio development, ecommerce and merch store setup, digital product launches (ebooks, courses, templates), and creator monetisation and growth strategy

quotes: Brand identity and visual design
Website and portfolio development
Ecommerce and merch store setup
Digital product launches (ebooks, courses, templates)
Creator monetisation and growth strategy

acceptanceCriteria: Services page lists all 5 service categories
Each service has a title and descriptive text
Page includes at least one CTA button

requirements.text: Build Launch Packages/Pricing page displaying service packages with realistic Indian Rupee pricing examples (₹1,999, ₹4,999, ₹14,999) and clear CTAs

quotes: Display all pricing in Indian Rupees (₹ INR)
Use realistic example pricing such as: ₹1,999, ₹4,999, ₹14,999

acceptanceCriteria: Pricing page displays at least 3 package tiers
All prices shown in ₹ INR format
Each package includes features/benefits and a CTA button
No dollar pricing appears anywhere

requirements.text: Create Demo Store page showcasing at least 3 products (Creator Hoodie merch, Monetisation Ebook digital product, Online Course/Digital Template) with product cards that are fully clickable and link to separate product detail pages

quotes: Include a Demo Store showcasing both physical and digital products
Each product must be fully clickable
When a user clicks View Product or Buy Now, it should open a separate product detail page

acceptanceCriteria: Demo Store page displays product grid with at least 3 products
Products include: Creator Hoodie, Monetisation Ebook, and Online Course/Digital Template
Each product card shows image, name, price in ₹ INR, and CTA button
Clicking product or CTA navigates to dedicated product detail page

requirements.text: Build individual product detail pages for each Demo Store product showing product image, name, full description, price in ₹ INR, and clear 'Buy Now' or 'Enquire Now' CTA button

quotes: it should open a separate product detail page that includes: Product image, Product name, Product description, Price, Clear call-to-action button (Buy Now / Enquire Now)
Do not display full product details on the same page

acceptanceCriteria: Each product has its own detail page route
Detail page displays: product image, name, description, price (₹ INR), and CTA
CTA button is prominently displayed
Product details are not shown on Demo Store listing page

requirements.text: Create How It Works page explaining the service process in 3-4 clear steps: Brand Strategy & Planning, Website and Store Setup, Product & Merch Launch, and Monetisation & Growth, using icons and short descriptions

quotes: Create a How It Works page explaining the service process in 3–4 steps: Brand Strategy & Planning, Website and Store Setup, Product & Merch Launch, Monetisation & Growth
Use icons and short descriptions for clarity

acceptanceCriteria: How It Works page displays 4 process steps
Each step has an icon, title, and brief description
Steps are: Brand Strategy & Planning, Website and Store Setup, Product & Merch Launch, Monetisation & Growth
Visual hierarchy makes the process flow clear

requirements.text: Build dedicated Testimonials page displaying client testimonials with name, role (Content Creator/Influencer/Coach), and feedback text using cards or slider layout, including examples like 'Launchpad Studio helped me launch my merch store in under a week with a premium brand feel' and 'The website and product setup completely transformed how I monetise my audience'

quotes: A dedicated Testimonials page
Each testimonial should include: Client name, Client role (Content Creator / Influencer / Coach), Short feedback
Display testimonials using cards or sliders so they stand out visually

acceptanceCriteria: Testimonials page shows at least 3 testimonials
Each testimonial displays client name, role, and feedback quote
Testimonials use card or slider layout for visual prominence
At least one testimonial matches the provided examples

requirements.text: Create Contact/Book a Consultation page with consultation booking form and contact details

quotes: Contact / Book a Consultation

acceptanceCriteria: Contact page includes a consultation booking form
Form has fields for name, email, and message/inquiry
Contact details or business information is displayed
Page includes prominent CTA button

requirements.text: Implement modern, premium, creator-focused design with clean layouts, strong visual hierarchy, consistent typography and spacing, and professional footer with navigation links, contact details, and copyright text across all pages

quotes: Modern, premium, creator-focused design
Clean layouts with strong visual hierarchy
Consistent fonts, spacing, and alignment
Professional footer with navigation links, contact details, and copyright text

acceptanceCriteria: Design feels modern and professional throughout
Typography and spacing are consistent across all pages
Visual hierarchy guides user attention effectively
Footer appears on all pages with navigation, contact info, and copyright
Overall aesthetic is creator-focused and premium

requirements.text: Ensure every page includes at least one clear, prominent call-to-action button with conversion-focused text like 'Book Free Consultation', 'View Launch Packages', or 'See Product Details' that links to relevant pages or forms

quotes: Include at least one clear CTA on every page
Use strong CTA buttons such as: 'Book Free Consultation', 'View Launch Packages', 'See Product Details'
Ensure all buttons link to pages or forms, not just scrolling

acceptanceCriteria: Every page has at least one CTA button visible
CTA text is action-oriented and conversion-focused
CTAs link to appropriate pages or forms (not scroll anchors)
Buttons are visually prominent and consistent in style

requirements.text: Design the site with a modern, sophisticated color scheme and visual style that conveys professionalism, confidence, and premium quality suitable for a creator-focused digital marketing studio, using a cohesive palette and consistent design language throughout all pages

quotes: Professional, modern, confident, and business-oriented
The website should feel like a real, professional service-based digital business

acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme is modern and sophisticated (not blue & purple unless intentional)
Design conveys premium quality and professionalism
Visual style is consistent across all pages
Overall aesthetic matches a creator-focused brand studio positioning

constraints: All pricing must be displayed in Indian Rupees (₹ INR) with no dollar pricing
Website must be multi-page with separate routes, not a single scrolling page
Product detail must not be displayed on the Demo Store listing page - each product requires its own detail page
nonGoals: Portfolio-style layout instead of business website
Showing full product details on listing pages
